title: The look switch: what it is made of
caption: The switch holds one thing: which theme and style are on. It reads the site's themes and words, its module writes a press on the page and in the browser, and another tab's pick comes back through Followed.

state.says: which theme and style are on

holds.name: the themes' group
holds.note: a button per theme, by name, in the order named; drawn when the site offers two or more

holds.name: the styles' group
holds.note: Dark and Light; drawn when the site offers any theme

around.name: SiteShell, ChatShell, AdminShell
around.heading: Who draws it
around.note: in the header's actions, the chat's settings and the admin sidebar's foot

around.name: SiteAreas
around.heading: What it reads
around.note: the themes, the first one named the default

around.name: ChatText
around.note: Theme, Style, Dark and Light, a site's own or the English

around.name: LookSwitch.razor.js
around.heading: Runs in the browser
around.note: writes a pick on the page's html and remembers it, and follows another tab
